ideas.pitch: An edge-deployed IoT system using low-cost turbidity and pH sensors connected via ESP32 to predict and alert authorities about industrial water pollution spikes in real time.
ideas.title: AquaSense-IoT-Spill-Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with Energy & Sustainable Technologies while mimicking the predictive environmental monitoring approach that won 1st place at the AquaSense IoT Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A microcontroller-driven waste sorting bin utilizing a camera module and a lightweight computer vision model to physically separate metal, plastic, and organic waste on a conveyor belt.
ideas.title: Autonomous-Garbage-Segregator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets Smart Infrastructure & Digital Ecosystems by delivering a physical, working prototype in line with the successful TechnoMorph garbage classifier project.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous drone flight controller and satellite data integration pipeline that scans industrial perimeters for unauthorized land use changes and boundary violations.
ideas.title: GeoNex-Industrial-Compliance-Drone
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-scoring formula of the GeoNex-ATLAS satellite monitoring project, appealing to Resilience & Emerging Technologies judges looking for real-world enforcement tools.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent IoT diagnostic platform running locally on edge hardware to detect micro-grid power anomalies and autonomously reroute distribution feeds using fast machine learning.
ideas.title: AutoOps-Smart-Grid-Diagnostic
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines robust closed-loop industrial IoT operations with proven multi-agent diagnostic patterns that secured 3rd place at SEAL Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A solar-powered mesh network node equipped with thermal and gas sensors running local anomaly detection models to provide early wildfire risk assessment in remote forest regions.
ideas.title: Wildfire-Edge-Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the exact focus of the Sacramento State AI Hackathon winner by providing a quantifiable risk assessment tool for environmental disaster prevention.
